FULL TEXT:
Applications invited for appointment of Multi Task Staff (1) on contract
basis in Alumni House
NOTICE FOR APPOINTMENT OF MULTI TASK STAFF (IN OFFICE)
Application are invited on plain paper for the post of Multi Task Staff (1) for the Alumni
House, Panjab University, Chandigarh purely on contract basis for a period of 89 days on fixed
D.C. rates (Rs. 18,461/-) as may be applicable time to time payable from Panjab University
Alumni Association own budget. Applications along with brief biodata and attested
photocopies of various certificates and testimonials should reach the office of the undersigned
latest by 23rd June, 2023 till 4:30 p.m.
Essential Qualifications and Requirements:
1. Age should not be less than 20 years and more than 35 years as on closing date
prescribed for receipt of application.
2. Should be in good health (mentally and Physically)
3. Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks in aggregate.
Desirable Qualification:
1. Graduation in Computer Application or Diploma of Computer from recognized
University.
2. Knowledge of MS office, well versed in making presentations, use of Internet, good
typing skills and drafting of letters with minimum 3 years experience of working in
office.
Applicants are advised to see the website of Alumni Association for interview date for the
above mentioned post and also they can enquire on official telephone no. 0172-2541881.
Prof. Anupama Sharma
Dean Alumni Relations
Panjab University
Chandigarh
Note: The post is purely temporary. There will be no financial liability on the part of the
University after the termination of tenure and the applicant will be treated as relieved from
the Department of Alumni Relations, Panjab University, Chandigarh and he/she has no right
whatsoever to avail for the above service for permanent in nature. No TA/DA will be given
to applicants.
Issued to:
Website of the Department for General public and Heads of the teaching and non teaching
Departments of PU.
